description: What only a device with a vibration motor has. The haptics plugin is a dependency on iOS and Android alone and is registered there alone, so the permission is granted there alone — the same isolation desktop.json gives autostart. Nothing else needs it: the taps are the confirmation added on top of Lumen's own light when a hold opens or ends the voice session (docs/68), and the iPad, which has no motor, gets the light and nothing else.
